senses.gloss:
वोढव्य a. to be carried, drawn, borne, married,
undertaken, accomplished.

वोढृ॑ a. carrying, drawing, leading, bringing. m. horse
or ox of draught (±रथस्य or हलस्य);
 carrier, charioteer,
offerer, husband.

वो॑ढृ a. carrying, drawing, leading, bringing. m. horse or
ox of draught (±रथस्य or हलस्य);
 carrier, charioteer, offerer,
husband.
